paragraphs.comment: "ముక్తాత్మలకు (ముక్తులు)": the bracketed gloss is nominative while it glosses a dative.

"మహాత్ముడు వ్యాపించి నివసిస్తాడు": for "the great Self", మహాత్ముడు is commonly read in modern Telugu as 'a great person / saint'. The English translates the word, so a clearer rendering helps (the ta and hi versions were flagged for the same point).
paragraphs.suggestion: … ఈ పుణ్య నగరంలో (శరీరంలో) పరమాత్మ వ్యాపించి నివసిస్తాడు కనుక ఆయన పురుష అని పిలువబడతాడు

theologicalConcerns: ¶5 (English): "must rely on bhakti yogam to reach the Lord" names only bhakti yoga as the means for baddha souls; a Sri Vaishnava reader may expect prapatti (śaraṇāgati) to be acknowledged. The Telugu follows the English without added emphasis.
¶7 (English): "have earned a permanent place" implies attainment by merit, whereas in Sri Vaishnava doctrine mokṣa is the Lord's grace. The Telugu follows the English ("సంపాదించుకున్న").
